scale.kicker: text-[0.625rem] md:text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.15em] lg:tracking-[0.25em] font-body font-medium text-brand-navy-soft

rules: Use font-style: italic for accent phrases in headlines (e.g., 'Procurement that *travels borders*').
Kickers and pills must be strictly uppercase with heavy letter-spacing.
Stats and big numbers use Libre Baskerville weight 300.
Tables must use monospaced numbers (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums) within IBM Plex Sans.

usage: No purple/violet gradients. No AI-slop color palettes.
Sidebar and hero left-split MUST use brand_navy (#0f1b3d).
Main content background uses brand_pale (#e8edf3) for a newspaper-like contrast.
Accents, active borders, and primary buttons use brand_navy_soft (#3b6fa0).

spacing_and_layout.scale: Compact enterprise spacing: use Tailwind standard 4, 8, 16, 24, 48, 96, but apply padding heavily to containers and sparingly to dense data.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Sharp corners everywhere (rounded-none). The ONLY exception is pill badges which are rounded-full.

buttons.primary: bg-brand-navy-soft text-white shadow-[0_10px_25px_-5px_rgba(15,27,61,0.25)] hover:bg-opacity-90 rounded-none inline-flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-3 font-body font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-white border border-brand-navy-soft/50 hover:bg-brand-navy-soft/10 rounded-none inline-flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-3 font-body uppercase tracking-wider text-sm
buttons.dark: bg-brand-navy text-white hover:bg-brand-navy-deep rounded-none inline-flex items-center gap-3 px-6 py-3 font-body uppercase tracking-wider text-sm

cards.default: bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-none hover:border-brand-navy-soft transition-colors duration-300 shadow-sm
cards.frosted_live_card: backdrop-blur-xl bg-brand-navy/80 border border-white/10 rounded-none absolute z-10 p-6 md:p-8 shadow-2xl

component_patterns.pills: rounded-full uppercase text-[0.625rem] tracking-[0.15em] px-3 py-1 bg-gray-100 text-brand-navy font-medium border border-gray-200
component_patterns.tables: Dense, sharp borders, sticky headers. th: bg-gray-50 text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 font-body. td: text-sm text-gray-900 border-b border-gray-100 hover:bg-brand-navy/[0.04] tabular-nums
component_patterns.stat_blocks: Kicker/label above in uppercase. Big number in Libre Baskerville 300. Optional left border color-bar (4px wide).

micro_motion.live_pulse: Green dot pulses using 2s cubic-bezier. Animate a ring expanding and fading.
micro_motion.scroll_reveal: Live card fades up on scroll (opacity 0 -> 1, translateY 1.5rem -> 0 over 0.8s).
micro_motion.hover_states: Cards border-color transition to navy-soft. Table rows get 4% navy tint. Keep transition durations under 300ms.

landing_page.hero: Split layout. Left: brand_navy, logo top-left, pill 'Est. 2026 · 30+ Jurisdictions', serif headline 'Procurement that *travels borders*.', body text, dual CTAs. Right: full-bleed image (hero-containers.jpg) with linear-gradient(to right, #0f1b3d, #0f1b3d 20%, transparent) overlay.
landing_page.frosted_card: Absolutely positioned over the hero image. 3 stat rows (Open Tenders, Vetted Vendors, Board Liquidity), large Libre Baskerville numbers, green pulsing LIVE badge.
landing_page.section_2: Grid cols 4fr/8fr. Left: kicker + serif title 'One board. Every jurisdiction.' + body. Right: 3 feature cards with icons (1px borders, hover border-color navy-soft).
landing_page.section_3: Grid cols 4fr/8fr. Left: primary CTA. Right: numbered step-list 'From registration to award, in four moves.' (01/02/03/04 in accent color).
landing_page.footer: brand_navy background. Centered serif title 'Ready to bid across borders?', body text, dual CTAs.

auth_pages.layout: Split layout. Left: brand_navy, logo lockup, tagline 'Global Tender Board', subtle image excerpt, testimonial. Right: form on brand_pale, sharp inputs, serif headline 'Welcome back.' with italic.

dashboard_shell.sidebar: Left sidebar, 280px width, brand_navy background. Logo + role at top. Nav items: icon + label, active state gets 4px left border brand_navy_soft + slight pale-gray text lift. Bottom: 'Signed in as' + logout.
dashboard_shell.header: Top header, white bg, pmc-label kicker + serif page title + primary action button. Subtle bottom border.
dashboard_shell.right_rail: TenderFeed component. 280-320px width, white bg, border-l border-gray-200, navy accents on badges. Use green #22c55e for live pulse.

tender_detail.layout: Two-column. Main: doc-type + status pill, kicker + serif H1, description, RFP evaluation framework, addenda accordion, Q&A thread, dense bid comparison table. Right rail: Budget card (FX chip), deadline, attachments.
tender_detail.comparison_table: Sticky left column, monospaced numbers, LOWEST/TOP labels in brand_navy_soft uppercase 10px, SEALED cell shows pmc-label muted uppercase.
tender_detail.panels: Two-envelope panel and approval panel styled as bordered blocks with left-4-color-bar (warning for pending, primary for two-envelope).

dashboards.layout: 4-column KPI/stat grid at top (each: pmc-label kicker + Libre Baskerville big number + tiny sub-text + optional left color-bar). Below: data table for recent activity.
dashboards.buyer: Primary CTA 'New Tender' in header (big navy-soft button).
dashboards.vendor: Registration-status banner if not yet approved.

instructions_to_main_agent.assets: Ensure logo is placed at /frontend/public/pmc-logo.png and hero image at /frontend/public/hero-containers.jpg. Reference these directly in img tags.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: You MUST add `<link href='https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=Libre+Baskerville:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&display=swap' rel='stylesheet'>` to /frontend/public/index.html inside the <head> tag.
instructions_to_main_agent.tailwind_config: Update tailwind.config.js to include colors: brand-navy (#0f1b3d), brand-navy-deep (#1e3a5f), brand-navy-soft (#3b6fa0), brand-pale (#e8edf3), brand-surface (#ffffff). Extend fonts with 'display': ['Libre Baskerville', 'serif'] and 'body': ['IBM Plex Sans', 'sans-serif'].
instructions_to_main_agent.css_globals: In index.css, set body { font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; background-color: #e8edf3; }. Create utility classes `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-dark` with exactly the requested shadow and sharp borders.
instructions_to_main_agent.components_ui: When using Shadcn components (Cards, Buttons, Inputs, Tables), manually strip out 'rounded-md', 'rounded-lg', etc., and replace with 'rounded-none'. Replace any default 'font-sans' or 'Inter' with our typography tokens.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: CRITICAL: DO NOT REMOVE ANY `data-testid` ATTRIBUTES on any element. This is a visual UI redesign only; the test suite relies on these attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing_api: Preserve all existing routing and API contracts exactly as they are.
instructions_to_main_agent.dark_mode: DO NOT add a user-facing dark-mode toggle. The aesthetic relies on the sidebar being strictly dark (#0f1b3d) and the content area being strictly light.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Institutional gravitas means taking inspiration from Bloomberg Terminals and Financial Times: dense information, muted sophisticated palettes, explicit hierarchy.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Use asymmetric split layouts to create visual tension.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (like the frosted Live Tenders card).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur), but never over complex typography where contrast fails.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Apply specific transitions (colors, transform).
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Always use SHARP button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style. ONLY use rounded-full for pills/badges.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Rely exclusively on lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Data tables must be dense and use tabular monospaced numbers. Do not over-pad tables.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
